protocol.hypothesis: Joint sparse convex fitting can use witnessed contrasts more effectively than the fixed128 greedy coordinate updates, without adding runtime model types.
protocol.objective: Root-normalized witnessed pair logistic loss plus L1 + L2/2 on difference-RMS-normalized coefficients. Joint coefficients, no fixed handwritten utility or prior margin. RMS uses only training pair differences, floor1; root-constant columns remainzero.
protocol.selectionRule: Choose one global minimum character->family->root clipped pair log loss on the unchanged100-root inner holdout; exact tie favors largerL1. No role-head cherry picking.
protocol.fullFitGate: Only if chosen candidate beats the previous394-root FM1 loss; refitexact494-root graph, actualC#parity, thenfixed5+10outergate. Finalsealed.
